verdict.rationale: Capacities offers a REST API (Bearer/OAuth2 auth) that can create/manipulate content programmatically, which supports wiring it into scripts and workflows, but there's no documented URI scheme, deep-link handler, or local endpoint for opening/creating notes from outside apps — the API is the only documented external-driving mechanism. Missing for 10: URI scheme / deep link support, local HTTP endpoint for note creation, independent/hands-on confirmation of API usage in real workflows.
